Ben / Priyom — quick notes from finance side before we reply to BlueFront: 

1) Provisional PO policy: we can issue a provisional PO up to the provisional spend cap recorded on the vendor form. Anything above that requires a spend-cap exception and finance sign-off (ticket PROC-5182).

2) Looking at the attached provisional_po_alloc.csv, the CSV total is $52,100 (line items: $18,600; $20,000; $9,500; $4,000). That exceeds the stated $45,000 cap.

3) Line item #3 discrepancy — BlueFront says $9,500 vs form $4,500. We should confirm their intent; if $9,500 is correct we need a spend cap increase request. If $4,500 is correct we can issue a provisional PO for $45k and include a note to reconcile invoice line items once the master contract is in place.

Action options: 
- Ask vendor to confirm corrected total and optionally resubmit revised CSV (fast).
- Issue provisional PO at the $45k cap and request vendor to split invoices if they need to bill beyond that (slower reconciliation, requires accounting flags).
- Approve temporary spend-cap increase to $55k for onboarding (requires finance approval + executive sign-off).

Ben — can you pull up PROC-5182 and add an estimated delta if we go the temporary increase route? Priyom, can you draft language to send to the vendor asking for the corrected CSV and whether they request a single provisional PO?

Karthik
Senior Procurement Manager

Hi Alice — thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. Quick summary and next steps below.

Summary: 
- Our procurement team reviewed your submission. The CSV you sent totals $52,100; the vendor form shows a $45,000 provisional cap. Line item #3 should indeed read $9,500 (your finance confirmed to us on a quick call). That creates a $7,100 overage relative to the stated cap.
- We can issue a single provisional PO to cover the $45,000 cap immediately (PROV-PF-993-01). That will allow you to begin onboarding and bill up to $45k.
- For the $7,100 difference we can either: a) approve a temporary onboarding top-up to $55,000 (requires expedited finance approval and a one-time executive sign-off), or b) have you split invoices and submit the additional $7,100 under the master agreement once fully executed.

Requested next step from BlueFront: please confirm which option you prefer. If you want the single provisional PO only, we will issue PROV-PF-993-01 for $45,000 now and include a reconciliation note on the PO. If you prefer the top-up to $55,000, please reply and we will route PROC-5182 for expedited approval (estimate 24–48 hrs).

Attachment note: we've uploaded your original PDF and CSV to ticket PROC-5182 for audit. DocuSign for the onboarding SOW will be sent once the spend approach is finalized: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/EF3A2B7C
